narrative: OMX30 enters Tuesday in strong bull regime (+9.3% above 200-MA) with robust momentum (ROC-90 +14.4%), but critical overbought signals flash red: RSI at 81.82 and stochastic K/D inverted at 79.2/83.9 flag imminent mean reversion risk. Global backdrop shows mixed signals—Nikkei +2.08% supports risk appetite, but NASDAQ -0.32%, FTSE -0.35%, and rising VIX (+3.76%) suggest caution. Weighted correlation near flat (-0.006%) offers no directional anchor. The index sits 0.6% from 52-week high in upper Bollinger band; technically stretched but ADX 71.2 confirms strong trend structure. Execution risk is material: overbought retail positioning could trigger fast pullback on any negative catalyst, but momentum remains bullish.
morningBrief: OMX30 opens on a technical knife-edge: bull market structure intact (above 200-MA, MACD bullish, ADX 71.2 strong), but RSI 81.82 and stochastic inversion scream mean reversion. Watch 3123 (yesterday close) for support; if broken, 3085 (lower Bollinger) next. Resistance 3180 (50-MA) is battle line—failure there triggers unwind. Sector flow: Banks rally on US 10Y +84bp, NIM expansion; Industrials (Atlas, Volvo) benefit from USD/SEK +0.20% export tailwind; Boliden outperform on copper/gold strength. Tech/telecom headwind from NASDAQ weakness and rate compression. Risk-off rotation to pharma (AstraZeneca) if equity momentum breaks. Key event: US Jobless Claims 14:30 CET—if hot, expect VIX spike and rate rip, testing bull thesis. Morning trade: fade rallies into overbought, nibble longs only on dips to 3100 support. Hedge long positioning.
